item.title: Nupur Sanon gets engaged to Stebin Ben, flaunts massive diamond ring; sister Kriti Sanon hugs couple
item.description: Sharing the milestone moment with their parents, Nupur and Stebin were also on a video call with them after the proposal. Dressed in a pretty floral dress, Nupur also flaunted her giant engagement ring. Stebin opted to wear blue formals for the special occasion.

item.title: Bengaluru to get 153-acre Biodiversity Park honouring Basavanna, Cabinet approves Rs 250 crore project
item.description: He said people need lung space as Bengaluru is increasingly turning into a concrete jungle. "Bengaluru should not become another gas chamber. Establishing a large park in the city has been an unfulfilled dream of nature lovers for the past one-and-a-half centuries," he said.

item.title: Sriram Raghavan's Ikkis disclaimer says "neighbouring country can't be trusted", Reddit asks "Dhurandhar effect?"
item.description: Sriram Raghavan's Ikkis has landed in a soup for its strongly worded disclaimer against Pakistani army despite an even tone throughout the film.

item.title: After record selling last year, India's strong fundamentals to attract net FII inflows in 2026: Analysts
item.description: The year 2025 saw record foreign institutional investor (FII) selling in India but significant improvement in the country's fundamentals is likely to attract net FII inflows in 2026, analysts said on Saturday.

item.title: Over 150 Booked as J&K Police Crack Down on Banned VPN Usage
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir Police have launched a Valley-wide campaign against the use of banned Virtual Private Network (VPN) services, booking over 150 individuals in the last three days.

item.title: Venezuela declares national emergency after Caracas blasts, rejects 'US military aggression'
item.description: The statement added that President Nicolas Maduro had "ordered all national defence plans to be implemented" and declared "a state of external disturbance." The government said the attacks were reported in Caracas and in the states of Miranda, Aragua and La Guaira.

item.title: 'Mera dimaag hila hua hai…': Sunny Deol cries, opens up about mental health after father Dharmendra's death at Border 2 event in Jaisalmer
item.description: Sunny Deol, who will next be seen in Border 2, attended the launch of the song Ghar Kab Aaoge in Jaisalmer, where he became emotional while recalling how his late father, Dharmendra, inspired him. Directed by Anurag Singh, Border 2 serves as a spiritual sequel to JP Dutta's magnum opus Border (1997)

item.title: Indore gets new municipal commissioner, water quality inspection begins in Bhagirathpura
item.description: The development came a day after the Chief Minister Mohan Yadav ordered to suspend the Indore Additional Commissioner Rohit Sisoniya and Sanjeev Shrivastava, who is the Superintendent Engineer In-charge of the Public Health Engineering department.

item.title: Govt bars pre-booking tips on cab apps, allows women to choose female drivers
item.description: The Centre has amended the Motor Vehicles Aggregator Guidelines to ban pre-ride tipping prompts on cab apps and allow passengers, especially women, to choose same-gender drivers where available.
